cornerCallouts: They're flying down the Esses now, a real test of car balance and driver commitment.
Through Turn 3, a deceptively tricky corner that can easily catch you out.
Heading into the fast right-hander of Turn 5, momentum is key.
Negotiating the complex of Turn 6 and Turn 7, precision is paramount.
Now the drivers brake hard for the tight right-hander of Turn 10a.

strategyPoints: Tire degradation will be a major factor on this abrasive surface. Managing the rubber is crucial for a strong finish.
The pit window is relatively long here at Road Atlanta, so teams will need to carefully consider their strategy.
Fuel consumption will be a concern, particularly in the closing stages of the race.
With several heavy braking zones, brake wear could also play a significant role.
The undulating nature of the circuit puts extra stress on the suspension components.
Running a long first stint to gain track position could be a viable option, but it comes with risks.
The safety car could play a major role here; a well-timed pit stop under caution could be a game-changer.
Getting a good exit out of the final corner is crucial for maximizing speed down the front straight and setting up an overtake into Turn 1.
weatherCommentary: The Georgia heat is relentless today, putting extra strain on the drivers and their equipment.
There's a chance of thunderstorms later in the afternoon, which could throw a wrench into the strategy.
The humidity is high, making it even more challenging for the drivers inside the cockpit.
The track temperature is soaring, impacting tire grip and performance.
A slight breeze is helping to cool things down, but it's still a scorcher out there.
